statement: Under the exact C81 original disk, closed discrete free proper operator and transitivity hypotheses, with compact quotient N=O/Q, the entire actual boundary-fixed centralizer C_Q is contractible by a continuous identity-fixed homotopy in its original map-and-inverse topology. Literal descent and the unique x-fixed lift identify its entire point stabilizer with Homeo(N rel {p})^0 as topological groups. An explicit global section of actual evaluation gives inverse homeomorphisms C_Q <-> O x C_Q(x), and the displayed product contraction retains every original boundary point and individual deck label. All compact nonorientable quotients, including the Klein bottle, are included.
depends_on: C81 actual evaluation bundle, local sections and metric isometry; C82 quotient triangulation and the verified Haver1975 Lemma1 subdivision; C88 exact compact-parameter identity-extension criterion; C90 normalized pointed compact-surface contraction from Yagasaki2000 Lemma2.1(i); Epstein1966 Theorem6.3 for the constructed proper based homotopy, including its topological case; all cellwise, lift, topology, section and inverse formulas proved here
manuscript_passages: Section 23, folios 140-141, scans 279-281; Part C(b), original-boundary discrete-operator zero-level kernel and its full cocompact contraction.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The entire point-stabilizer image in the pointed identity component is proved from its actual equivariant lift, and every comparison uses the original disk, quotient and deck labels.
computational_checks: This is a topological proof with no numerical or finite counterexample. Fifteen unique equation tags and balanced display delimiters were structurally checked. The numbered proof was compared exactly with the independently read repaired refinement, allowing only claim-environment and equation-number changes.
source_verification: Epstein original Theorem6.3 printed pp99-101 and AppendixA4 p107 read; pp99 and101 rendered and actually viewed. Its proper-homotopy boundary-pair and fixed-basepoint clauses, and topological proof paragraph p101, apply exactly. Yagasaki Lemma2.1(i) pp2-3 and all exceptions reread. Haver publisher PDF pp457-458 reopened; its k=0 subdivision lemma is stated without proof and no source proof is claimed to have been read. Existing verified bibliography records are reused.
notes: This strengthens C90 to one contraction of the whole group for a compact actual quotient. It proves the full point-stabilizer/pointed-component identification and explicitly constructs a continuous global evaluation section. The general noncompact quotient deformation remains unresolved.
